products.name: Google Cloud Network Architecture & VPC Service Controls (Shared VPC, Private Access, Perimeters) — Commercial
products.short_description: Design a secure Google Cloud network — Shared VPC, private API access, firewall/egress policy, and VPC Service Controls perimeters that stop data exfiltration — so workloads connect privately and data stays inside trusted boundaries. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Design a secure Google Cloud network with data-exfiltration perimeters

A flat, default Google Cloud network with public API access is an exfiltration risk and a compliance gap. This solution designs the enterprise network: a Shared VPC topology, private connectivity (Private Google Access / Private Service Connect), hybrid connectivity patterns, firewall/egress policy, and VPC Service Controls perimeters that stop data from leaving trusted boundaries — so workloads reach Google APIs privately and data stays inside the perimeter.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the network reference: Shared VPC, private access, hybrid connectivity, firewall/egress model, and VPC Service Controls perimeter design.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Organization/landing zone, network admin roles, connectivity, gcloud toolchain).
  • Implementation Guide — build the Shared VPC + subnets, enable private access, apply firewall/egress policy, and design + enforce VPC Service Controls perimeters (dry-run first) — pilot-first, each artifact named.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (private access works, perimeter blocks exfiltration in dry-run then enforced) plus Best Practices for evolving perimeters safely.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A Google Cloud network that connects workloads privately and holds data inside enforced perimeters — exfiltration paths closed, access least-exposed — safe by design.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 6 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • gcpnet_config_helper.py — scope/config helper: emit expected config & check live drift (read-only)
    • gcpnet_network_assessment.py — read-only Google Cloud network exposure assessment
    • gcpnet_perimeter_report.py — VPC-SC perimeter + private-access validation report (read-only)
    • gcpnet_private_access_validate.py — validate Private Google Access is working (read-only)
    • gcpnet_shared_vpc_provision.py — provision the Shared VPC host + private-access subnet (dry-run default)
    • gcpnet_vpcsc_perimeter_build.py — build a VPC Service Controls perimeter DRY-RUN first (safe default)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
